description: This file provides utility functions for formatting INR currency amounts both as individual values and as ranges, with support for Indian numbering system and compact notation.

methods.name: formatINRCompact(amount)
methods.description: Formats a numerical amount into a compact string with the Indian Rupee symbol and units like L and Cr, using Indian numbering conventions.

methods.name: formatINRRange(min, max, { compact = true } = {})
methods.description: Formats a salary range in INR into a string, either in compact form with units or full numeric form, based on options.
